docs: Update README to use Makefile targets (#193)

The root README still described the create-solana-program template:
the pnpm scripts it lists (programs:*, generate*, validator:*) no
longer exist since the root package.json has no scripts, and there are
no local validator scripts. Document the Makefile targets used by CI
instead, and drop the validator sections since tests run on Mollusk
and LiteSVM.
